offer.text: I've goods to sell but the road to the next village runs through rough country. Keep me safe and I'll lead the way to the market town.

accept.text: Wonderful. Stay close and let me pick the path.

decline.text: Then my wares stay in the cart another week, I suppose.

in_progress.text: The market's not far now — mind the road behind us.

ready.text: Stalls and customers at last! We've arrived.

complete.text: A safe road and a full market — couldn't ask for more. My thanks, friend.
